:::{#thm-score-second-moment}
#### Second moment of the score

Under the assumptions of @thm-score-mean-zero,
the second moment $\E{\score^2}$ of the [score](#def-score) $\score$
is the [expected information](#def-einf) $\einf(\param)$,
the expected negative second derivative of the log-likelihood:

$$\E{\score^2} = \einf(\param)$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-score-second-moment, worked in @sol-score-second-moment.
It builds on @thm-score-mean-zero and @lem-deriv-log-density.

:::
